description: Read-only, source-owned index of scientific data feeds. The bridge links existing chemical identities to source-bound claims without promoting evidence.
doctrine: IDENTITY ≠ OCCURRENCE ≠ BIOSYNTHESIS ≠ BIOACTIVITY ≠ HUMAN EFFECT ≠ SAFETY
relationship_semantics: MENTIONED_IN_CITED_CLAIM means a source-linked claim refers to the molecule; it does not prove clinical efficacy, safety, dosage or any new chemical identity.

domains.title: Cancer research and supportive-care evidence
domains.human_efficacy_warning: Cannabinoids are not established anticancer treatments in humans. Do not replace oncology care.
